compute_dataset_size: compute the total size response for a huggingface dataset by aggregating config and split sizes
run_dataset_size_job: run the dataset-size job runner to calculate dataset storage metrics and row counts
get_dataset_size_info: get dataset size information including parquet bytes, memory bytes, and row counts
aggregate_config_sizes: aggregate config-level size data into a combined dataset size response with progress tracking
handle_pending_configs: handle pending and failed config-size jobs while computing overall dataset size
